title: Next Term? Sequences and Series Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
2, 5, 10, 17... what comes next? Some friends say 24, some say 26. In this animated lesson on NCERT Chapter 8, Sequences and Series, we stop guessing and find the rule, so we can get the next term or even the 100th term.

A canteen queue shows what a sequence is and why order matters. Then n counts up live while a square of dots grows, and the rule an = n^2 + 1 appears on its own. We compare a formula rule with a step rule (the Fibonacci sequence), see finite and infinite sequences, and watch the odd numbers build perfect squares as a series. Sigma notation, an NCERT exercise worked step by step, the exam trap about where counting starts, an original JEE Main pattern question, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
